title: Maintain original native migration provider/source parity after protected blog handoff repair
root_cause: Original protected PR #5648 applied its Supabase DDL migration 20261112140500 after source merge, while original immutable provider-backed source lock still reflected 827 migrations (last 20261112131500). Historical migration lock controls would reject any next unrelated migration candidate until source parity recovered.
impact: Original owner CI/CD may block protected downstream releases even though production blog handoff guard is live; would create repeatable source-history drift.
fix: Append only the exact 828th provider-applied version and name independently read from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations, preserve all prior 827 identities and SQL, use original protected GitHub source lock, no DDL replay or parallel executor.
prevention_rule: After native Supabase provider migrates a protected original SQL change, verify provider row count and exact version/name, reconcile original migration-history.lock.json using original owner before admitting dependent protected releases. Never claim future planned migrations applied.
evidence: Verified 2026-11-12T13:37:15.498091Z production Supabase supabase_migrations.schema_migrations has 828 rows and exactly one row version 20261112140500/name original_blog_provider_identity_handoff_v1.
Protected PR #5648 was merged on main as fc4cf2b22875ddc27c1a11f3021c966ed5a0c539 after Required+CodeQL+Supabase preview all passed.

Production pg_get_functiondef of powerhouse_content_handoff_receipts_v1 includes exact first-party /blog/ provider proof gate and still requires social post IDs and provider_truth_verified. Original 2026-10-25 BRAIN item advanced from OVERDUE_PUBLICATION to OVERDUE_MEASUREMENT; no false outcome claimed.
Original source lock contained 827 exact provider applied identities ending in 20261112131500, before this append-only 828 reconciliation.
outcome: Provider backed historical source lock reconciliation; proves release integrity only, not historical 183 social metrics or business conversion.
